items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.contentSnippet:
The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
https://impeccable.style

Impeccable
 
Design guidance for AI coding agents. 1 skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration, and 62 deterministic detector rules for AI-generated frontend design.
 
 
 
Quick start: From your project root, run npx impeccable install, then run /impeccable init inside your AI coding tool. Full docs: impeccable.style.
 
 
Why Impeccable?
 
Anthropic's frontend-design was the first widely-used design skill

items.title: Show HN: Kashkeshet – non-opinionated agent-to-agent chat MCP server in Rust
items.contentSnippet:
This is hardly a greenfield area. There are tons of agent-to-agent communication apps. But, at least to my taste, a lot of them are too complicated or too opinionated. If we learned anything from the HuggingFace incident, it's that modern AI agents don't need a lot of help communicating. They are smart and creative and figure it out.

items.title: The focus on AI safety disasters ignores everyday harms
items.contentSnippet: Consider what passes for success in technology policy. An AI company promises that its chatbot will not encourage suicide. A social media platform makes it more difficult for children to buy fentanyl. These are important protections, and they should have existed all along. But companies can clear these low bars while continuing to make products…
